\begin{figure}[t]
  \centering
  \includegraphics[width=\columnwidth]{figures/fig_sandy_worked_example}
  \caption{One document end to end. (1) An excerpt of the 12{,}000-character
  window passed to the model; shading marks the source spans supporting
  \texttt{evidence\_snippets}. (2) The resulting record, abridged:
  \texttt{key\_impacts}, \texttt{evidence\_snippets} and
  \texttt{missing\_information} are shown as counts. The observed output
  contains five evidence snippets, exceeding the contract's maximum of
  three reported in Table~5; the saved record is reproduced without
  truncating that field. (3) The five location
  strings after geocoding, as the union of their resolved geometries --- the
  city, borough and neighbourhood levels overlap, and the two New Jersey
  refinery sites resolve to separate polygons. These resolved location
  geometries do not establish the hazard footprint. Every element is recoverable
  from the emitted row: the snippet, the location string and admin level it
  came from, and the geometry it resolved to. This record was judged correct
  (\S\ref{sec:validation}); that judgement does not imply compliance with
  the snippet-count limit. Basemap \copyright{} OpenStreetMap contributors.}
  \label{fig:worked-example}
